objects.text:
Paint Board is a fully open-source, web-based creative canvas.All data is stored in 
the current browser’s IndexedDB; there are no cloud backups, and no login is required

The drawing mode supports a variety of brushes, as well as doodles, text, and images, 
with a wide range of drawing tools to unlock your limitless creative potential

The selection mode is used to adjust existing drawings; it supports dragging, zooming, 
and moving all drawing content, and allows for further editing

Each canvas supports unlimited dragging, moving, and zooming, as well as a wide 
range of background settings

Seamless switching between multiple canvases is supported to meet your extensive 
creative needs
